title.narrative: UNICEF-Cuba improved the quality of maternal and child care in a crisis context, in coordination with MINSAP, EPI, APS and CNRS. Support was provided to 7,311 professionals in maternal and child care, vaccination, neonatal health and pediatric road trauma. 100% of one-year-old children were vaccinated with;MMR;vaccine, purchased by UNICEF-Cuba.
